question: Who was the compiler of the book 'I AM?', which was launched in February 2025 by Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar, the Honourable Vice President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gopichand P Hinduja**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gopichand P Hinduja** is a prominent industrialist and co-chairman of the Hinduja Group, one of the largest diversified groups in the world.
 
• The book **'I AM?'** was compiled by **Gopichand P Hinduja** and launched in **February 2025** by **Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar**, the Honourable Vice President of India.
 
• The book captures the **philosophical insights** and **spiritual reflections** of Gopichand P Hinduja, offering a blend of personal experiences and wisdom for self-discovery.
 
• The launch of the book signifies its importance in the domain of **spiritual and philosophical literature**, aimed at inspiring readers to introspect and explore their inner selves.
 
• The event was graced by several dignitaries, emphasizing the significance of the book in contributing to the **intellectual and spiritual discourse** in modern society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Gopichand P Hinduja:**

 
 
• He is one of the four brothers leading the **Hinduja Group**, which operates in over 30 countries with businesses spanning sectors like automotive, healthcare, energy, and finance.
 
• Gopichand P Hinduja is known for his commitment to **philanthropy** and his interest in **spiritual and philosophical studies**.
 
• He has played a vital role in expanding the Hinduja Group's global footprint, making it one of the most influential business conglomerates in the world.
 
 
 
• **The Book 'I AM?':**
 
 
• The book explores themes of **self-awareness, spirituality, and the quest for meaning** in life.
 
• It is a reflection of Gopichand P Hinduja’s personal journey, offering insights into his **spiritual beliefs** and **life experiences**.
 
• The title **'I AM?'** signifies the profound question of identity and existence, encouraging readers to delve deeper into their inner consciousness.
 
 
 
• **Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar:**
 
 
• He is the Honourable **Vice President of India**, serving as the second-highest constitutional authority in the country.
 
• Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar has a distinguished career in politics and law, and his presence at the book launch highlights the significance of the event.
 
 
 
• **Hinduja Group:**
 
 
• Founded in 1914, the Hinduja Group is one of the world's largest diversified business groups with interests in sectors such as **banking, automotive, IT, energy, and healthcare**.
 
• The group is headquartered in London, UK, and operates globally, employing thousands of people across various industries.
 
• It is renowned for its commitment to **corporate social responsibility** and **philanthropic initiatives**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Philosophical Literature:**

 
 
• Books like **'I AM?'** contribute significantly to the genre of **philosophical and spiritual literature**, offering insights into the deeper aspects of human existence.
 
• Such works often blend **personal experiences** with universal truths, making them relevant to a wide audience.
 
 
 
• **Global Influence of Indian Authors:**
 
 
• Authors like Gopichand P Hinduja highlight the growing influence of **Indian thought and philosophy** on the global stage.
 
• These works resonate with readers worldwide, reflecting India's rich heritage of **spirituality and introspection**.
 
 
 
• **Role of Dignitaries in Promoting Literature:**
 
 
• The presence of prominent figures like **Shri Jagdeep Dhankhar** at book launches underscores the importance of literature in shaping society.
 
• It also encourages readers to engage with works that offer **intellectual and spiritual enrichment**.
